以下是基于微软 FY26 Q4 官方财报材料的完整分析。

---

## 1. Intelligent Cloud 分部收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | 金额 | 出处 |
|------|------|------|
| Q4 FY26 Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306M | press_release.txt, Segment Revenue 表 |
| Q4 FY25 Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $29,878M | press_release.txt, Segment Revenue 表 |
| 同比增长 | ($39,306 − $29,878) ÷ $29,878 = **31.6%** | 计算得出 |

管理层在新闻稿中披露为 **32%（GAAP）**，恒定汇率口径下为 **31%**（press_release.txt）。计算值 31.6% 与报告值 32% 一致（差异源于四舍五入）。

---

## 2. 管理层归因（电话会记录原话）

以下为 Amy Hood 在 FY26 Q4 电话会上对 Intelligent Cloud 增长驱动因素的表述（transcript.txt，约第 24700–25100 字符）：

> **"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."**

> **"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."**

总结为四条归因：
- **A.** 客户需求持续超过可用产能（"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"）
- **B.** CPU/GPU 集群的效率提升（"efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet"）
- **C.** 流程改进使新产能更早交付，且当季产能被快速变现（"process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity…quickly monetized"）
- **D.** GitHub Copilot 6 月商业模式调整后消费超预期（"stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change"）
- **E.**（本地服务器业务）续约合同结构带来更高的当期收入确认（"renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts"）

---

## 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

逐条区分如下：

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|---|------|------|----------|
| A | 客户需求超过可用产能 | **已发生事实** | Amy Hood 原文用陈述语气"continues to exceed"，描述的是 Q4 当季已观察到的状态；她还引用现货市场定价作为佐证（transcript.txt 第 40000+ 字符："you can even see it…in some of the pricing that's occurring in the spot market"）。 |
| B | CPU/GPU 效率提升 | **已发生事实** | 原文"Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by** efficiency gains"，用的是过去时态的归因，描述 Q4 已实现的成果。Amy 在 Q&A 中进一步确认"we saw a good work this quarter"（transcript.txt 第 40000 字符）。 |
| C | 流程改进使新产能更早交付并快速变现 | **已发生事实** | "process improvements…enable earlier delivery"以及"quickly monetized"描述的是 Q4 当季已完成的动作和结果。 |
| D | GitHub Copilot 6 月商业模式调整后消费超预期 | **已发生事实** | "following the June business model change"——6 月的调整已落地，"stronger-than-expected"是相对于预期的已实现结果。 |
| E | 续约合同结构带来更高当期收入确认 | **已发生事实** | 描述的是 Q4 当季本地服务器业务的实际结果。 |

**前瞻性表述（不属于本季度归因，但出现在同一份电话会中）：**

Amy Hood 在展望 Q1 FY27 时有关于未来的表述（transcript.txt，第 32535 字符附近）：

> *"In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency and we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply. Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate."*

这是**前瞻性表述**，依据是：使用了"we expect""we remain focused on""we continue to expect"等未来指向性措辞，且涉及尚未发生的季度（Q1 FY27 及 H1 FY27）。

---

**总结：** 管理层列出的五条 Intelligent Cloud 增长归因全部是对 Q4 FY26 已发生事实的陈述，无一为前瞻性表述。前瞻性表述仅出现在同一份电话会的"展望"部分（Q1 FY27 指引），与当季归因明确区分。
